translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: Efesios
book.title: Efesogi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Garda Narmaksad Efesios

content: Bemar Bab-Dummad-mimmigan, gwallu-meegwad gumalad
Degisoggu, bemar Bab-Dummad-mimmigan-sabemaladmarsoggu, Bab-Dummad-daedba be damarsun.
Degi, sabguedgi be nanamar, ar igi Cristo anmar-sabgusmoga, degine, ise-wawadik Bab Dummadga ibmar-gummakar-uklegedyob, anmar-ular na e-san uksamogadyob.

Ar bemar Jesucristogi akananai-gumarsoggu, bipisaale mer bemargi sunmaked be imakmar, bemar abirgunagwarsuli neg-sichigi yoledimarye, bemar galagwensuli nanadimarye, degine, bemar ibmar-bina surbinsa itodamarbarye.

Gaya-iskanase-bakale, mer egi be sunmakmar, mer binsa galagwensuli be sunmakmar, mer sunnasur gaya-iskanagi sunmaklemaladgi be sunmakmar, suli, we-gaya-degimalad, ib-nuedsulid, bur Bab Dummadga dog-nuedye, be sogmar.

Ar bato bemar wisid, dule abirgunagwarsuli na neg-sichigi yolemalad, dule galagwensuli gudimalad, degi, dule dogdar ibmar-bina surbinsa na itodamalad, bab-dummadyob-imaklemalad na e-bab-dummadga na imakdimalad, amarga igar gwen maisulid, Bab Dummad, degi, Cristo-neg-dakmaidse doged.

We-igar-iskana an bemarga sogedgi, dulemar a-igargi sogmalad, we igar-gwen-akarsuliteye, amarse mer be yardakleged imakmalo, ar dulemar degi-galagwensuli-daedbali Bab Dummad dulemar-uaya-surdamalad odurdakde-daed.
Degisoggu, amar-degi-damaladbali mer eba ibmar-iskana be imakmar.
Ar epennedi bemar neg-sichigi galagwensuli gudigusmalanad, ar emigindi Bab-Jesúsgi bemar gwallu-meegwadyob gumarsoggu, gwallu-meegwadyob be nanamarsun.
Ar Bab-Dummad-Burba-Nued-daedi wegiido: Bela igar-nuegangi nanaed, igar-inikigwadbi imaked, degine, igar-napiragwadbi saed.
Degisoggu, be durdakmarsun igid-igar Bab-Jesús nabir-ito imakedi.
Mer ibmar-iskana neg-sichidgi binsa imaklemaladba be ibmar imakmar. Suli, degisur. Amarga bur be oyoged-sae ibiga wede ibmar-iskana gue.
Ar ade we ibmar-iskana na dukuar imakdiidgi be sunmaker ib-nued-sulid, agi be sunmaked be binge itoge-wilubbid.
Ar bela ibmar gwallu-meegwadse onolesale, mag dakle-daed ibmar-iskanamar, ar gwallu bela ibmar mag dakle imaked.
Ar a-ulale soged:
Degisoggu, be daedgine nue be nanamarsun, melle dule-ibmar-wichurmaladyob be damar, dule-nue-ibmar-wisidyob be nanamarsun.
Ibagan-nagumaid nue be ebumar, ar ade ibagan-iskana bukidar nagumaid.
Degisoggu, melle binsaed-suli be nanamar, binsaed-nikaa bur be damar, igi Bab-Jesús nanabi bemar-abemai, a bemar mag itoged imakmarsun.
Degine, melle be mungumar, ar adi galagwensuli dule-onana-saed. Bur bela-bela Bab-Dummad-Burba-Nued-nika be nanamar.
Na be muchub-muchub salmosgi, degine, Bab-Dummad-nug-odummoged-namakedgi, degine, burba-ogannoged-namakedgi be namakdii imakmar, degine, Bab-Jesús-nug ogannodii be-gwagegi be imakmarsun.
Bab Dummadga, anmar-Babga guedgi, bela dogdar-nuedye anmar-Bab-Jesucristo-nuggi sogdigu imakmarsun.
Bab-Dummad-dobegwaa, na be muchub-muchub urbaligwaa na be nanamar.
Ome sui-urbaligwaa nanaoed, degi, sui nue ome-sabgumogoed
Omegan-sui-nikmalad, na be-sui-urbaligwaa nanamar, igi Bab-Jesús-urbaligwaa bemar nanadimala, deyob be nanamar.

Ar ade sui ome-e-dummadga gusiid, igi Cristo na eba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad-dummadga gusimoga, degisoggu, na eba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad, a, Cristo-e-sanga gusisundo, degine, Cristo Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad e-Abonogedsundo.
Degisoggu, ar igi Cristoba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad Cristo-sogedba nanadii, debayobi omegan-sui-nikmalad e-sui-urbaligwaa bela nanamogodo.
Machergan, na be-ome be sabgumar, ar igi Cristo na eba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad-sabgusmoga, degine a-bina burgwega igi na san uksagusa.
Adi Bab Dummadgadga imakega deun nue swilidik imaknonigu, deun digi-ogleged-igar imaksagu, na e-gaya-burba sogedba.

Adi Cristo na eba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad bela gwage nue swilidikidgi, degi, bipisaar iskued naisulidgi na dukin ega na ukega, igi ome-sui-nikunaid bela yeer daklege, gwen gutu naisuli, bapi-bapidsuli, bela nued daklegedyob.
Cristo na eba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad-sabguedyobi sui na e-ome-sabgumogar-gebed, ar igi na e-san sabgumogadyob. Ar dule na e-ome-sabele, na dukin e-san sabgued.
Ar dule bipisaale e-san na istar geg daked, bur-bule e-san na nued akwed, degi, nue na masgi ogunbalid. Ar deyob Cristo na eba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad dakmogad.
Ar ade anmar Cristo-e-san-bakadid, e-sana, degi, e-galagan anmar gumalad.
We wargwenna gunoni-daedi, igar-dummadid, nue aku itolegedid. We degi-an-sogedi, Cristo, degine, na eba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad-ebo igar-maidgi an deyob soged.
Degisoggu, bemar na wala-walagwen ar igi na-be-san sabmala, deyob na-be be-ome sabgumogoed, degine, ome, e-sui nue na dakee nanamogoed.
